articles.title: Powerful Japanese Proverb of the Day: ‘If you talk about tomorrow, the demons...’ - Why planning without present action fuels procrastination
articles.description: Numerous individuals often get lost in grand visions for the future, neglecting the importance of decisive action in the present. An age-old Japanese saying underscores the limitations of forecasting what lies ahead, urging us to refrain from excessive daydreaming. Instead, it champions the value of taking incremental steps today, emphasizing that consistent effort is vital in transforming aspirations into tangible achievements.

articles.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has ruled out deploying troops or military assets to the Middle East in connection with the ongoing US-Iran war, saying Seoul will not engage in the conflict. However, he said South Korea is considering limited measures to protect its merchant vessels, oil routes and citizens amid growing concerns over the Strait of Hormuz. The decision comes after reported US pressure on Seoul to play a more active role in safeguarding navigation. Lee also said a possible meeting between US President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un could take place in the coming months, although he stressed that no such summit was certain.
